documentDescription: API reference for the runtime route segment config option.
content:
The runtime option allows you to select the JavaScript runtime used for rendering your route.

export const runtime = 'nodejs'
// 'nodejs'

export const runtime = 'nodejs'
// 'nodejs'

'nodejs' (default)'edge' (deprecated)

Good to know:The Edge Runtime is deprecated. Remove the runtime export from your route files. See Edge Runtime Deprecated.This option cannot be used in Proxy.
